journeys.name: b5-general-key-cable-two-student-lifecycle
journeys.note: Electronic-key group training (generalKeyPat) on a fixed 12-group cable floor, frontend payloads (list.js:124, teacher.js:310, handKeyTrain.js:104/238/455/489/569). Teacher (sweep-admin, creator role=1) + sweep-student + seeded b5k-stu2; b5k-out is a non-member. Covers WS online/ready/pat/finish/begin/end relay, topic/role errors, heartbeat, roster, 207/208 precedence, upload replay/conflict/extension, settlement (student1 one wrong group; student2 finishes in the 60 s grace window with no pages), statistics, export, delete closing sockets. Determinism: cable source is fixed; upload intervals are fixed ([0,400]) and the 0.5 s sleep after start plus the WS settles keep them below the server elapsed bound; scores derive only from fixed content; only serverElapsedMs and validTime are masked. pageValue omits the source id (servers ignore it). Expected diffs: see generalKeyPat.md.

journeys.name: b5-general-key-generated-reset-export-import
journeys.note: Generated (isCable=0) 250-group training: add pre-generates pages 1-2, page 3 is lazy. Upload, reset to attempt 1, stale-attempt 208 fence on upload/start/reset/finish, empty finish (missing-page arithmetic), lazy page 3 after finish, end, reset after end, statistics, export, delete, admin import of each stack's own archive, detail and delete of the import. Generated group keys are random and therefore masked; scores of the empty finish do not depend on them.
